title: Culture, Heritage & the World in 2050
content:
Cornelius Holtorf presented a lecture entitled “Heritage Futures: Culture, Heritage & the World in 2050” for more than 100 students and researchers (26 November 2026).

The online event was part of the Global UNESCO Chair Lecture Series IV: The World in 2050. This series brings together lectures by various UNESCO Chairs dealing with the future. It is arranged collaboratively by the UNESCO Chair in Interdisciplinary Anticipation and Global-Local Transformation at Eurac Research Bolzano/Bozen in Italy, the School of Transformation and Sustainability at the Catholic University Eichstätt-Ingolstadt in Germany, and UNESCO’s Futures Literacy and Foresight Unit forming part of its Management of Social Transformations Programme.
